question: Which of the following crop is known as “Golden Fibre” of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jute.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jute:-
 
 
• Itis known as the** "Golden Fibre" of Bengal** due to its** golden color **and **high economic value.**
 
• It is a **fiber crop **that is widely grown for its** strong, durable, and eco-friendly fibers.**
 
• It is an important source of raw material for the** textile and packaging industries.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Soyabean**:

 
 
• It is a** legume crop** that is widely grown for its edible seeds.
 
• It is an important source of **protein and oil **for human consumption and animal feed.
 
 
 
• **Corn:**
 
 
• It is a **cereal crop **that is widely grown for its edible grains.
 
• It is an important source of** food, feed, and industrial products **such as ethanol and starch.
 
 
 
• **Rice:**
 
 
• It is a **cereal crop **that is widely grown for its **edible grains.**
 
• It is an important **staple food **for millions of people around the world.
